{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Identify the rows where conversion failed
df_invalid = df[df['revenue_numeric'].isna()]

# Display the invalid revenue values
invalid_revenue_values = df_invalid['revenue'].unique()

# Check the status of invalid rows
invalid_statuses = df_invalid['status'].unique()

invalid_revenue_values, invalid_statuses"}
